hints.title: Fixed Size Substring Window
hints.text: Maintain a window of fixed length k and count how many vowels it contains.

hints.title: Slide Window Forward
hints.text: When moving from i - 1 to i, subtract 1 if s[i - k] was a vowel, and add 1 if s[i] is a vowel.

hints.title: Track Maximum Vowels
hints.text: Maintain the maximum vowel count seen across all windows of length k.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Counting vowels from scratch in every k-length substring takes O(N * K) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding window updates vowel count in O(1) per step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses fixed-length sliding window adding incoming character and removing outgoing character.
complexity.notes: Vowels are a, e, i, o, u.
